article.headline: When Every AI Wedding App Looks the Same, Who Wins?
article.description: 3,600+ wedding-tech companies. AI features converging in weeks. In a world where every AI wedding app looks the same, distribution, proprietary data, network effects, brand trust, workflow lock-in, ecosystem breadth, and execution speed decide who wins — not AI itself.
